title: Case 1: Superintendence, Direction & Control of Elections in ECI (Article 324 • Writ Petition)
factualMatrix: Before the Supreme Court of India (Article 32), an aggrieved petitioner challenged an impugned executive notification and enforcement order issued by the Union Ministry / Central Authority under Article 324 (Superintendence, Direction & Control of Elections in ECI) of Part XV (Elections). Relying on the core guarantee that Vests the plenary constitutional authority for the superintendence, direction, and control of all elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of President and Vice-President in an independent Election Commission of India (ECI), providing... and citing Mohinder Singh Gill v. Chief Election Commissioner (1977), the petitioner sought judicial invalidation for violating constitutional limits and procedural fairness.

modelAnswer:

SUBSTANTIVE ANALYSIS (Article 324): Vests the plenary constitutional authority for the superintendence, direction, and control of all elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of President and Vice-President in an independent Election Commission of India (ECI), providing...
